description: This is a PHP source file defining the Special controller class within the OpenCart framework. The class manages the display of special products, including loading models, formatting product data, and rendering the 'special' products view.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for handling special product listings in the OpenCart framework, extending the core Controller class and implementing the index method to generate product data for view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method of the Special controller that loads language, models, fetches special products, processes product data including images and prices, and renders the 'special' products view.
